verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਸਹਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatisaahu beparavaahu athaahu sahaabaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is the carefree emperor, unfathomable and full of all qualities of a master.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੁਹਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: naau gareeb nivaaj hai bemuhataaj na moh muhaabaa|

en.bdb: His name is cherisher of the poor; neither He has attachment with anyone nor is He dependent on anybody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਲਾਹ ਸਿਞਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: besumaar nira(n)kaar hai alakh apaar alaeh sin(j)aabaa|

en.bdb: Formless, infinite and imperceptible, He is having all the attributes which deserve praise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਮੁ ਦਾਇਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਾਜਰੁ ਵੇਦ ਕਿਤਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaim dhaim saahibee haajar naajar vedh kitaabaa|

en.bdb: The mastery of the true Guru is eternal because all the Vedas and other holy scriptures are always present before Him (for His praises).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਡੰਡੀ ਛਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: agam addol atol hai tolanahaar na dda(n)ddee chhaabaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is beyond all measures; He cannot be weighed on any scale.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਛਤਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਂਵਦਾ ਦੁਸਮਣੁ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਸੋਰ ਸਰਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: eik chhat raaj kamaa(n)vadhaa dhusaman dhoot na sor saraabaa|

en.bdb: Uniform is His kingdom wherein there is no enemy, no friend and no noisy clamour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਲੁ ਅਦਲੁ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ਜਾਲਮੁ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਨ ਜੋਰ ਜਰਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: aadhal adhal chalaidhaa jaalam julam na jor jaraabaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is judicious; dispenses justice and in His kingdom no atrocity and tyranny is exacted.
Such a grand Guru (Nanak) is the manifest spiritual teacher of the whole world.
